      "observations": [
        "All 177 owned diff lines across two paths were read. The edit caller no longer turns a handler check into a separate show Boolean and no longer normalizes absence to an empty string. updateItemURL instead toggles both row/separator from the passed value, returns for falsy values, and retains zero-delay deferred href/value assignment for a present URL. No test changes accompany this landing.",
        "The removed showOrHideItemURL rejected missing values, invalid URIs, unknown handlers and external schemes lacking a registered app. Those gates no longer decide whether the edit row is visible. The old updateLink utility/export is also removed; an exact parent-revision calendar search finds its definition but no other calendar invocation. Fixed summary display already trims and toggles from presence, so display policy is aligned without proving link activation succeeds.",
        "The actual getProperty receiver returns null for an absent normal-item property. Optional ?.trim() therefore passes undefined to updateItemURL. The adopted @param {?string} annotation describes a nullable string but does not name the actual undefined caller value; the implementation's falsy early return handles it. A scoped JSDoc correction would describe the optional/undefined input or normalize it, without changing runtime behavior. This is distinct from a missing-should finding or a runtime exception.",
        "The xhtml gives the URL label a control target and wires click/command separately to launchBrowser. Accepted launchBrowser has its own guards and external-link path; visible text is not a protocol authorization or successful native launch. No external protocol implementation or linked Betterbird patch was inspected.",
        "No assertions change. A bounded search of Calendar/browser tests found the existing eventDialog EVENTURL used as an attachment fixture, not a direct unregistered-protocol URL-row assertion in the inspected scope. The removed comments about handler validation do not survive as a rule. The retained crop workaround names a non-obvious reason, while short hide/show/set comments mostly narrate the code. The falsy guard keeps deferred work out of a nested branch; distinct visibility/guard/deferred steps remain grouped.",
        "The complete primary current0–2, updates/footer and complete own review were read from exact retained captures. The reported summary/edit visibility inconsistency and copying impediment are historical observations; the implemented removal of handler-based display gating is checked directly. External Betterbird/earlier-bug links remain unread.",
        "Own review proposes an undefined-aware optional annotation through a bot comment, while the human reply requests {?string}. Actual owned and accepted source adopt {?string}; their caller still produces undefined for an absent URL and the guard handles it. This scoped documentation mismatch remains distinct from runtime behavior and from any claim that displaying a scheme authorizes opening it."
